title: checkout order
description: The 201 response body of POST /orders served by the examples/checkout echo server.

order_id.description: Server-assigned order identifier: ord- followed by 12 lowercase hex characters.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the order was priced in.

items.description: Order lines echoed from the request body.

sku.description: Product identifier of the ordered line.

unit_price_cents.description: Unit price in cents for this line.

total_cents.description: Order total in cents: the sum of quantity * unit_price_cents over items.
